author: hana
text: Month-end invoicing run is stuck again. ledger-db is throwing deadlocks, invoices are ~6h behind. Opened PLAT-88, @tomasz can you take a look?

author: tomasz
text: On it. This is the MySQL row-lock issue again on the ledger_entries table. Long term we need real serializable transactions — I'll write an RFC.

author: grace
text: Reminder: team offsite is March 12 in Lisbon. Please book flights by Feb 15 🙏

author: hana
text: SEV2: Friday afternoon deploy of payments-gateway broke Stripe webhook signature checks. Webhooks failing for ~3h. Rolled back manually. PLAT-102.

author: omar
text: Second Friday incident this quarter. I'm going to write down a deploy window policy in the eng handbook.

author: omar
text: SOC2 audit observation window is May through August, so we're freezing risky infra changes. That means Project Atlas cutover can't happen end of Q2 — I propose moving the ledger-db cutover to Oct 28.

author: arjun
text: Agreed. Atlas cutover is now Oct 28. @tomasz keep dual-write work going in the meantime.

author: tomasz
text: 👍 Oct 28. I'll start dual-write after the audit kicks off.

author: elena
text: Our auditors flagged that invoices and ledger records must be kept for 7 years for tax purposes. Our data-retention policy deletes everything 90 days after cancellation. Proposal: invoices + ledger records are exempt from the 90-day deletion and are retained for 7 years.

author: maya
text: Approved. Invoices and ledger records: 7-year retention. Everything else stays at 90 days. @nina please update the deletion job.

author: nina
text: Will do — Sam will take it as DATA-41.

author: ravi
text: Customers on Pro keep hitting the public API rate limit (100 req/min). Proposal: raise it to 300 req/min for Pro.

author: omar
text: 300 is a lot for our current gateway. Let's do 250 req/min for Pro and 1000 req/min for Enterprise.

author: arjun
text: Ship it: 250 Pro / 1000 Enterprise.

author: priya
text: Given BILL-212 (refund abuse — 41 cases in July, people charging and refunding at day 25-29), I propose we cut the refund window from 30 days to 14 days for monthly plans. Annual plans keep prorated refunds.

author: elena
text: Finance supports this. The abuse cost us roughly $18k in July alone.

author: maya
text: Approved. Refund window for monthly plans is 14 days, effective Sept 1. Annual stays prorated. @priya please make sure support docs and the help center get updated.

author: priya
text: Will do. Diego will implement it in refund-engine (BILL-219). @jordan can your team update the support playbook and the help center refund article?

author: jordan
text: 👍 on it

author: arjun
text: Now that every product change ships behind feature-flags and Hana's 1-click rollback is live in deploy-pipeline, I'm lifting the Friday deploy freeze. Fridays are fine for flagged changes. Unflagged infra changes still only Mon-Thu.

author: omar
text: +1. I'll update the release section of the eng handbook.

author: chloe
text: SSO is the #1 blocker on 3 enterprise deals right now (Globex, Initech, Umbrella). What's the ETA on Okta SAML?

author: carlos
text: Initech asked again today. They need SSO enforcement per workspace, not just login.

author: ravi
text: SAML parsing is merged, enforcement per workspace is my next PR. Realistically mid-October for Okta.

author: sofia
text: Because the Atlas cutover is Oct 28 and usage pricing needs per-event ledger writes on Postgres, we're moving usage-based pricing GA from Nov 15 to Dec 1 to leave a buffer.

author: priya
text: Makes sense. Billing side (meter consumer) will be ready by Nov 10.

author: chloe
text: I'll update the launch comms and the pricing page date.

author: tomasz
text: Heads up: I'm going on parental leave from Nov 2 for 3 months 🍼 I'll do handovers before I go.

author: grace
text: Congratulations Tomasz!! 🎉

author: carlos
text: Customer Acme Corp is quoting our help center: full refund within 30 days. But refund-engine rejected their refund at day 20 on a monthly plan. Which one is right??

author: mei
text: Our support playbook also says 30 days... let me check with someone and get back to you.

author: kai
text: Hi all! I'm Kai, just joined Platform 👋 Where's a good place to start understanding ledger-db and Atlas?

author: omar
text: Welcome Kai! Tomasz is the person for anything ledger-db. Start with RFC-007.
